rows.l1_text: Gothic cathedrals, which developed in medieval Europe, fascinated people with their overwhelming height and beauty.
The wisdom of the architectural engineering of the time was brought together in their construction.
Particularly noteworthy are the techniques called the "rib vault," which distributes the weight of the ceiling, and the "flying buttress," which supports from the outside of the wall.
Thanks to these, it became possible to make the walls thin and provide large windows, and the interior was filled with light.

Ukiyo-e is a unique craft that developed in Japan, and an art that is highly regarded worldwide.
Production is carried out through a division of roles among the painter, the carver, and the printer.
It goes through a complex process in which the carver carves the painter's draft drawing onto a woodblock and the printer prints it onto paper.
Especially in the case of multicolour printing, a different woodblock must be used for each colour, and the advanced skill and cooperation of the craftsmen are essential.
In this way, a single picture is completed.
